purpose: Throwaway pipeline-validation set. NOT the curated research library. Used only to confirm the ligand-prep -> Vina docking pipeline runs end-to-end and is reproducible against the 5XYA + 7EDD receptor ensemble before real compound curation is approved.
caveats: Raw AutoDock Vina scores are size/scale biased; this set is not a rigorous hit-discrimination benchmark.
Positive-control motifs (aryl amidines) engage serine-protease pockets generally, not SpyCEP specifically.
